**Retiam** is a WebGPU-powered 2D/3D mathematical animation and rendering engine inspired by Manim. Built natively with TypeScript, WGSL compute shaders, order-independent transparency (OIT), and hardware-accelerated path tracing, Retiam allows you to create high-fidelity technical animations, 3D visualizations, interactive graphics, and videos.

blocks.text: Retiam is built around a few foundational building blocks:

items: **`Scene`**: The orchestrator. Manages the WebGPU render loop, timeline execution, camera viewports, and animation dispatch queues.
**`Entity` / `VectorEntity`**: The base node in the Scene Graph hierarchy. All shapes, 3D models, camera, and groups inherit from `Entity`.

items.text: **`State`**: Contiguous Float32 memory mapped directly to WebGPU uniform buffers containing three sub-blocks:
children: `Paint`: 2D styling (fill color, stroke color, stroke width, opacity, line caps/joints).
`Transform`: Spatial location (4x4 matrix, position, rotation quaternion, scale, offset pivot).
`Material`: 3D PBR attributes (color, roughness, metallic, emissive, transmission, IOR).

items: **`Animator` (`entity.animate`)**: Fluent chainable API for scheduling state transitions over time.

11. CLI Commands: Video Rendering & Web Export
Retiam provides command-line tools to render your scenes directly to MP4 videos or compile standalone Web Component scripts for website embedding.

blocks.code: npx retiam <subcommand> [file] [flags]

blocks.text: Headlessly renders your scene frame-by-frame via Puppeteer and streams raw frames into FFmpeg to output an MP4 video.

blocks.code:
# Render default main.ts
npx retiam render src/main.ts

# Render at 4K 60fps with a 10 second maximum duration
npx retiam render src/scenes/MyScene.ts -w 3840 -h 2160 -f 60 -d 10000

# Enable Hardware Path Tracing with Raytracing
npx retiam render src/scenes/3DScene.ts --raytrace

blocks.text: Compiles any scene into a lightweight, self-contained JavaScript bundle (`dist-embed/<scenename>.js`) that defines the `<retiam>` HTML element tag.

blocks.code:
# Export scene to dist-embed/myscene.js
npx retiam export src/scenes/MyScene.ts
